abstract: This paper explores whether foreign aid is driven by a (hidden) contest amongst donors to access natural resources, exploiting the timing and size of major mineral discoveries using a gravity model for a large panel of countries. Results show that recipient countries that experience major discoveries receive more, not less, bilateral aid, all else equal. Our main result is not directly but rather indirectly driven by China which entry in the World Trade Organization in 2001 heightened the global competition for access to natural resources. We conclude that the energy transition and its requirement in minerals will further exacerbate the (hidden) contest amongst aid donors.

abstract: This paper examines intergenerational mobility in China and Russia during their transitions from central planning to market systems. We consider mobility as movement, measured as changes in status between parents and children. We provide estimates of two key mobility measures: overall mobility, which captures total intergenerational movement including the effects of changing class distributions across generations, and steady‐state mobility, which captures the long‐run mobility intrinsic to the intergenerational process once the class distribution has stabilized. We further decompose overall mobility into structural and exchange components. We find that China exhibits more overall educational mobility than Russia, mostly due to greater structural mobility, while Russia exhibits greater steady‐state educational mobility. Overall and steady‐state occupational mobility are similar in China and Russia. Comparing these results to the US, we find that educational steady‐state mobility is substantially lower in China than in both Russia and the US, with Russia being the most mobile, but occupational steady‐state mobility is comparable across all three countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国和俄罗斯在从中央计划经济向市场体系转型过程中的代际流动性。我们将流动性视为一种运动，以父母与子女之间地位的变化来衡量。我们提供了两个关键流动性指标的估计：总体流动性，它捕捉了包括代际阶级分布变化效应在内的总代际运动；以及稳态流动性，它捕捉了阶级分布稳定后代际过程固有的长期流动性。我们进一步将总体流动性分解为结构性和交换性组成部分。我们发现，中国的总体教育流动性高于俄罗斯，这主要归因于更大的结构性流动性，而俄罗斯则表现出更高的稳态教育流动性。中国和俄罗斯的总体及稳态职业流动性相似。将这些结果与美国进行比较，我们发现中国的教育稳态流动性显著低于俄罗斯和美国，其中俄罗斯的流动性最高，但三个国家的职业稳态流动性相当。

title: Conﬂicts of Interest in Banks: Evidence from Proprietary Trading
title_zh: 银行利益冲突：来自自营交易的证据
title_primary: 银行利益冲突：来自自营交易的证据

official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze the conflict of interest that arises when universal banks engage in proprietary trading of borrower stocks, which has been a prominent concern in the regulatory debates for a long time. We combine trade-by-trade supervisory data with credit registry information in Germany. Our findings reveal that lending relationships inform banks’ prop trading. To separate bank expertise and private information from lending as explanations, we study prop trading around corporate events. We show that banks execute purchases (sales) in borrower stocks in the weeks before positive (negative) news events, even when these events are unscheduled and surprising to the market. We link this trading pattern to situations when banks possess private borrower information, and rule out that it is explained by specialized expertise. We also find evidence consistent with information flows through banks’ centralized risk management, that banks alter trading patterns once they acquire private information, consistent with shrouding of informed trading, and that OTC counter-parties price-protect against relationship banks. Our evidence highlights the difficulty of avoiding conflicts in universal banking.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了全能银行在从事借款方股票自营交易时产生的利益冲突问题，这一直是监管讨论中的突出关切。我们将逐笔交易监管数据与德国信用登记信息相结合。研究结果显示，贷款关系为银行的自营交易提供了信息。为区分银行的专业知识与私人信息作为解释因素，我们围绕公司事件研究了自营交易行为。我们表明，在正面（负面）新闻事件发生前的数周内，银行会执行对借款方股票的买入（卖出）操作，即使这些事件是未安排的且对市场而言出乎意料。我们将这种交易模式与银行掌握借款方私人信息的情形联系起来，并排除了其由专业知识解释的可能性。我们还发现了与信息通过银行集中风险管理流动相一致的证据，即银行一旦获取私人信息便会改变交易模式，这与知情交易被掩盖的现象相符，并且场外交易对手方会对关系银行采取价格保护措施。我们的证据凸显了在全能银行中避免利益冲突的难度。

abstract: Abstract Repeated surveys of New York State anglers eliciting fishing trips taken are used to estimate the willingness-to-pay to avoid fish consumption advisories. We consider over 1,300 in-state origins and 1,700 destinations and use site-specific constants to address time-invariant unobserved characteristics. Conditional logit models produce WTP values between $2.91 and $5.96 per day, while mixed logit models give average values of $1.16 to $1.72. We also estimate the values of recreational amenities (such as boat launches), which can be used to offset resource losses.

title: Coping with off-farm employment shocks at the grassroots level in rural areas: evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic in China
title_zh: 农村基层应对非农就业冲击：来自中国新冠疫情的证据
title_primary: 农村基层应对非农就业冲击：来自中国新冠疫情的证据

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A better understanding of the effectiveness of grassroots coping measures against existing shocks is essential in case similar events arise in the future. This study examines how rural villages coped with off-farm employment shocks during the COVID-19 pandemic, using a panel dataset of 800 households in 100 villages across 25 counties in five provinces. Our data show that between the COVID-19 outbreak and April 2020, up to 81% of villages adopted at least one measure to support off-farm employment, such as providing job information, job offers and transportation subsidies or services. Regression results from both Propensity Score Matching and Instrumental Variable approaches consistently show that providing job information with job offers significantly reduced the probability of exiting off-farm employment and reducing working hours. Providing job information alone also reduced the probability of working fewer hours, but with little heterogeneous effects by gender, education or the village’s economic status. These findings provide valuable insights for other developing countries and can help inform policymakers about the effectiveness of grassroots responses to off-farm employment shocks. abstract_zh: 更深入地理解基层应对现有冲击措施的有效性，对于未来类似事件的发生至关重要。本研究利用覆盖五省25县100个村庄800户家庭的面板数据集，考察了农村村庄在COVID-19疫情期间如何应对非农就业冲击。数据显示，从疫情爆发至2020年4月，高达81%的村庄至少采取了一项支持非农就业的措施，如提供就业信息、工作机会及交通补贴或服务。基于倾向得分匹配和工具变量方法的回归结果一致表明，提供就业信息并附带工作机会显著降低了退出非农就业和减少工作时间的概率。仅提供就业信息也降低了工作时间减少的概率，但在性别、教育程度或村庄经济状况方面几乎没有异质性效应。这些发现为其他发展中国家提供了宝贵见解，并有助于政策制定者了解基层应对非农就业冲击的有效性。关键词：非农就业；基层应对措施；广延边际与集约边际响应；COVID-19；工具变量JEL分类：J21 J48致谢：我们感谢国家自然科学基金（项目编号72373140和71903185）的资助。

title: Beyond Productivity: Technology Adoption and Factor Allocation in Agriculture
title_zh: 超越生产力：农业中的技术采纳与要素配置
title_primary: 超越生产力：农业中的技术采纳与要素配置
title_secondary: Beyond Productivity: Technology Adoption and Factor Allocation in Agriculture

source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of agronomic technology adoption, induced by technical assistance programmes, on factor misallocation and aggregate agricultural productivity. While the literature has established the central role of land and capital market imperfections as sources of misallocation in agriculture, the potential of technological adoption to correct these inefficiencies has received limited attention. This paper directly addresses this gap by combining a calibrated equilibrium model with causal inference methods, using Chile as a case study. The results show that, among farmers whose adoption is induced by access to technical assistance programmes, factor misallocation is reduced by approximately 22 percentage points. This effect is robust across alternative efficiency measures, functional specifications and parametric assumptions, and remains stable after purging idiosyncratic productivity from agroclimatic conditions such as rainfall and soil quality. Technological adoption significantly increases participation in land rental markets and access to bank credit, thereby facilitating the reallocation of resources towards more productive farmers. In addition, the analysis identifies local spillover effects: farmers in municipalities with higher adoption rates exhibit lower misallocation. Counterfactual exercises further indicate that these effects are amplified when frictions in land markets are reduced.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了由技术援助项目引致的农艺技术采纳对要素错配和农业总生产率的影响。尽管已有文献确立了土地和资本市场不完善是农业错配的主要根源，但技术采纳在纠正这些效率损失方面的潜力却鲜受关注。本文通过将校准均衡模型与因果推断方法相结合，以智利为案例研究，直接填补了这一空白。结果表明，在因获得技术援助项目而采纳技术的农户中，要素错配降低了约22个百分点。这一效应在替代效率测度、函数设定和参数假设下均保持稳健，且在剔除降雨和土壤质量等农业气候条件带来的异质性生产率后依然稳定。技术采纳显著提高了农户参与土地租赁市场和获得银行信贷的机会，从而促进了资源向更具生产率的农户重新配置。此外，分析还识别出局部溢出效应：在技术采纳率较高的市镇，农户的错配程度较低。反事实分析进一步表明，当土地市场摩擦减少时，这些效应会得到放大。

title_zh: 外部收入作为信号：来自政治家与选民的证据
title_primary: 外部收入作为信号：来自政治家与选民的证据

authors: Carina Neisser, Nils Wehrhöfer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how public disclosure of politicians’ outside income affects their behavior. We exploit a disclosure reform targeting German federal MPs and tax-return data in a difference-indifferences setup using unaffected state MPs as controls. MPs increase their outside income by 24%, driven by likely right-leaning MPs. A representative survey experiment uncovers that right-leaning voters interpret outside income as a signal of competence and hard work, while left-leaning voters associate it with weaker representation. Consistent with this, we show that newspapers cover right-leaning MPs’ outside activities more favorably. Our findings suggest that politicians strategically use public disclosure as a signaling tool.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政治家外部收入的公开披露如何影响其行为。利用一项针对德国联邦议会议员的披露改革及纳税申报数据，在双重差分框架下以未受影响的州议会议员作为对照组进行分析。研究发现，议员的院外收入增加了24%，这一增长主要由倾向右翼的议员驱动。一项代表性调查实验揭示，右翼选民将外部收入视为能力与勤奋的信号，而左翼选民则将其与代表性不足相关联。与此一致的是，我们发现报纸对右翼议员外部活动的报道更为正面。研究结果表明，政治家会策略性地将公开披露作为信号传递工具。

title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
title_zh: 美国死亡率危机：普雷斯顿曲线的逆转
title_primary: 美国死亡率危机：普雷斯顿曲线的逆转
title_secondary: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
authors: Ritikaa Khanna, Rourke O'Brien, Andrew C. Stokes, Atheendar Venkataramani, Elizabeth Wrigley-Field
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and counties continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups. County-level decompositions are broadly consistent with arguments that longevity has fallen due to widely shared exposures to social deterioration, which may account for the Preston curve reversal. Collectively, we show that the recent U.S. mortality crisis reveals a weakening—and growing inequality—in the conversion of aggregate resources into longevity gains. We conclude that the recent U.S. mortality crisis could be understood not only as a story about particular causes of death, but also as a weakening of institutional and social translation.
abstract_zh: 美国人均预期寿命在2010年代陷入停滞甚至下降，尽管实际人均收入持续增长。我们运用普雷斯顿曲线将这一模式刻画为收入与寿命关系的转变。基于1980-2019年州级数据与2000-2019年县级数据，我们估算了以人口加权的普雷斯顿曲线，该曲线将预期寿命与对数化实际人均收入相关联。1980-2010年间，美国各州遵循经典普雷斯顿曲线模式：收入增长伴随预期寿命提升。2000-2010年间各县亦呈现相同趋势。然而2010-2019年间，各州与各县收入持续增长，但预期寿命停滞或下降。曲线向右平移却未向上移动，且斜率增大，表明出现脱钩与分化：随时间推移的总体资源增长不再带来广泛的寿命增益，且在任意给定年份，不同收入群体的预期寿命不平等程度加剧。这些模式在围绕大衰退的替代时间锚点检验中保持稳健，并以教育替代收入后依然成立。该模式同样存在于不同性别与种族群体中。县级分解结果与"社会恶化导致的广泛暴露因素造成寿命下降"这一论点基本吻合，这或可解释普雷斯顿曲线的逆转。综合来看，我们揭示近期美国死亡率危机反映出总体资源向寿命增益转化的弱化——以及转化过程中日益加剧的不平等。我们得出结论：近期美国死亡率危机不仅可被理解为特定死因的故事，更可被视为制度与社会转化机制弱化的表征。

abstract: The rapid expansion of high-speed internet has intensified concerns about how digital technologies affect early childhood. Using the staggered rollout of fibre optic to the home in Uruguay as a natural experiment, this column finds that greater lifetime exposure to high-speed internet reduces children’s scores in communication, problem solving, personal-social and socio-emotional skills. The effects are partly explained by indirect channels, through the displacement of valuable activities for child development and alterations in caregivers’ behaviour.
abstract_zh: 高速互联网的快速普及加剧了人们对数字技术如何影响幼儿发展的担忧。本文以乌拉圭光纤到户的分阶段推广作为自然实验，研究发现，儿童一生中接触高速互联网的时间越长，其在沟通、解决问题、个人社交及社会情感技能方面的得分越低。这种影响部分可通过间接渠道解释，即替代了有益于儿童发展的活动，并改变了照护者的行为模式。

abstract: Strong Nash implementation remains a central challenge in mechanism design, with no direct analogue to Maskin (1977) seminal theorem for Nash implementation under simple and widely applicable conditions. We revisit the structure of Maskin (1979) result and show that strong Nash implementability imposes a coalitional compatibility requirement, formalized by the coalitional intersection property. We then identify the Restricted Coalitional Intersection Property (RCIP) as a weaker implication of this requirement, imposing only limited compatibility across coalitions when comparing equilibrium outcomes under different preference profiles. To guarantee RCIP, we introduce a structural condition on the environment—Agents with Separately Exclusive Alternatives (ASEA)—which ensures RCIP for coalitions separating such agents. ASEA captures situations in which a pair of agents each strictly prefers its own designated alternative to that of the other, while all remaining agents weakly prefer any socially chosen alternative to these designated alternatives. We show that, in societies with at least three agents and containing at least one such pair, every social choice correspondence that is weakly Pareto optimal and satisfies a strengthened form of Maskin monotonicity—called Y-monotonicity—is implementable in strong equilibrium. We illustrate the applicability of our results in a variety of economic environments, including several-to-one matching markets, fair allocation, efficient sharing of commonly owned technologies, and coalitional games.
abstract_zh: 强纳什实施仍是机制设计中的一个核心挑战，在简单且广泛适用的条件下，尚无与Maskin（1977）关于纳什实施的奠基性定理直接对应的结果。我们重新审视了Maskin（1979）结论的结构，并表明强纳什可实施性施加了一种联盟相容性要求，该要求被形式化为联盟交集性质。随后，我们识别出受限联盟交集性质（RCIP）作为这一要求的较弱推论，它仅在不同偏好配置下比较均衡结果时，对联盟间的相容性施加有限限制。为保证RCIP成立，我们引入了一种环境结构条件——具有单独排他替代品的代理人（ASEA）——该条件确保了对分离此类代理人的联盟而言RCIP成立。ASEA刻画了这样一种情形：一对代理人各自严格偏好其指定的替代品而非对方的，而所有其余代理人弱偏好任何社会选择的替代品而非这些指定替代品。我们证明，在至少包含三个代理人且至少包含这样一对代理人的社会中，每一个弱帕累托最优且满足一种强化形式的Maskin单调性——称为Y-单调性——的社会选择对应关系都能在强均衡中实施。我们在一系列经济环境中展示了我们结果的适用性，包括多对一匹配市场、公平分配、共有技术的有效共享以及联盟博弈。

title: U.S. liquid government liabilities and emerging market capital flows
title_zh: 美国流动性政府负债与新兴市场资本流动
title_primary: 美国流动性政府负债与新兴市场资本流动
title_secondary: U.S. liquid government liabilities and emerging market capital flows
authors: Annie Soyean Lee, Charles Engel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We identify the liquidity channel through which Federal Reserve quantitative easing (QE) and quantitative tightening (QT) affect capital flows to emerging markets. Using weekly data on the Fed’s purchases and sales of long-term U.S. Treasury securities, we find that large purchases lead to a significant increase in capital flows to emerging markets, and that sales have the reverse effect. We then show that QE lowers, and QT raises, the convenience yield on U.S. Treasuries, measured by covered interest parity deviations, and that the induced changes in the convenience yield drive the capital flow responses. Our model based on liquidity rationalizes these findings: QE shifts publicly held government debt toward more liquid assets, providing investors a greater buffer against the risk of low consumption. Better insured through liquid asset holdings, investors are willing to increase illiquid investments, including lending to emerging markets.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了美联储量化宽松（QE）与量化紧缩（QT）影响新兴市场资本流动的流动性渠道。利用美联储购买和出售长期美国国债的周度数据，我们发现大规模购买显著增加了流向新兴市场的资本，而出售则产生相反效应。随后，我们证明QE降低了美国国债的便利收益率，而QT则提高了该收益率，这一指标通过覆盖利率平价偏差来衡量，且由此引发的便利收益率变化驱动了资本流动的反应。我们基于流动性的模型合理化了这些发现：QE将公众持有的政府债务转向更具流动性的资产，为投资者提供了应对低消费风险的更大缓冲。通过持有流动性资产获得更好的保障后，投资者更愿意增加非流动性投资，包括向新兴市场放贷。

title: The lasting effects of early childhood interventions: The National Vaccination Commando Program in Burkina Faso
title_zh: 早期儿童干预的持久影响：布基纳法索国家疫苗接种突击计划
title_primary: 早期儿童干预的持久影响：布基纳法索国家疫苗接种突击计划
title_secondary: The lasting effects of early childhood interventions: The National Vaccination Commando Program in Burkina Faso
authors: Richard Daramola, Md Shahadath Hossain, Harounan Kazianga, Karim Nchare
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study evaluates the long-term effects of a nationwide immunization program in Burkina Faso, known as the National Vaccination Commando Program, implemented in late 1984. Focusing on the measles vaccination component of the program and using a difference-in-differences approach, we find significant reductions in child mortality and improvements in educational attainment, including increased primary and secondary school completion. We also find significant positive effects on adult employment and agricultural productivity, yielding a substantial return on this early health investment. These findings underscore the lasting benefits of early childhood health interventions in low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了布基纳法索于1984年末实施的全国性免疫计划——“国家疫苗接种突击计划”的长期效应。聚焦于该计划中的麻疹疫苗接种部分，并采用双重差分法，我们发现儿童死亡率显著下降，教育成就有所提升，包括小学和中学完成率的提高。同时，我们还发现该计划对成人就业和农业生产力产生了显著的正面影响，为这一早期健康投资带来了可观的回报。这些发现强调了在低收入国家，儿童早期健康干预措施的持久益处。

title: Concrete Interests: Paramilitary City-Building in Rio de Janeiro
title_zh: 具体利益：里约热内卢的准军事城市建造
title_primary: 具体利益：里约热内卢的准军事城市建造
title_secondary: Concrete Interests: Paramilitary City-Building in Rio de Janeiro
authors: Pantaleão, Bruno
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do armed groups reshape cities? This article argues that Rio de Janeiro’s milícias—paramilitary organizations, frequently led by current and former security officers,—govern territory through “build-to-hold” urbanization. Rather than simply extracting rents, milícias construct informal housing to expand captive populations that generate recurring income, electoral leverage, and political protection. Combining geospatial data on territorial control with satellite-derived measures of urban development from 2016–2023, I use staggered difference-in-differences estimators to show that milícia entry causes sustained increases in building density and height. These effects are absent in gang-controlled areas and persist in territories transitioning from gangs to milícias, indicating that densification is specific to the milícia governance model. I further show that increased construction does not increase formal housing prices or transaction activity, consistent with a system in which armed actors retain control over housing assets rather than integrating them into formal markets. The findings demonstrate how criminal organizations actively produce urban space in ways that entrench coercive authority and blur the boundary between criminal governance and state power.
abstract_zh: 武装团体如何重塑城市？本文认为，里约热内卢的民兵组织——通常由现任或前任安全官员领导的准军事组织——通过“建设-持有”城市化模式统治领土。民兵组织并非单纯攫取租金，而是建造非正规住房以扩大受控人口规模，从而获取持续性收入、选举筹码和政治庇护。通过将领土控制的地理空间数据与2016-2023年卫星衍生的城市发展指标相结合，我采用交错双重差分估计量证明：民兵组织进入会导致建筑密度和高度持续增长。这种效应在帮派控制区域不存在，而在从帮派过渡到民兵组织的领土中持续存在，表明密度增长是民兵治理模式的特有现象。我进一步证明，建筑增加并未推高正规住房价格或交易活跃度，这与武装行为体保留住房资产控制权而非将其纳入正规市场的体系特征一致。研究结果揭示了犯罪组织如何通过主动生产城市空间来巩固强制权力，并模糊犯罪治理与国家权力之间的边界。

title: A Heterogeneous Agent Model of Energy Consumption and Energy Conservation
title_zh: 能源消费与节能的异质性主体模型
title_primary: 能源消费与节能的异质性主体模型
title_secondary: A Heterogeneous Agent Model of Energy Consumption and Energy Conservation
authors: VOLHA AUDZEI, IVAN SUTÓRIS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate monetary policy transmission and energy saving incentives in response to rising energy prices. We add energy in consumption and production, and energy conservation capital, to a tractable New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, unemployment risk, and nominal asset holdings. We find that monetary policy influences the energy conservation through both unemployment risk and asset returns; energy price shocks intensify monetary policy trade‐offs in terms of stabilizing inflation and output. A weaker policy response is beneficial in terms of agents' welfare despite higher inflation. The Ramsey policy predicts a strong rise in the policy rate with a decline afterward.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了能源价格上涨背景下货币政策的传导机制与节能激励。我们将能源纳入消费与生产环节，并引入节能资本，构建了一个包含异质性主体、失业风险与名义资产持有的可处理新凯恩斯模型。研究发现：货币政策通过失业风险与资产回报双重渠道影响节能行为；能源价格冲击加剧了货币政策在稳定通胀与产出之间的权衡。尽管通胀水平上升，但较弱的政策响应更有利于提升主体福利。拉姆齐政策预测政策利率将先大幅上升后回落。

title: Assortative Matching on Income
title_zh: 收入上的分类匹配

authors: Pierre‐André Chiappori, Carlo Fiorio, Alfred Galichon, Stefano Verzillo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze marital matching on income using an extremely rich Dutch data set containing all income tax files over seven years. We develop a novel methodology that directly extends previous contributions to allow for highly flexible matching patterns. Investigating all marriages that took place between 2013 and 2019, we find that marital patterns are particularly intriguing. While a majority of couples match assortatively, a small but significant minority display negative assortative matching. We also show that standard approaches, which consider all married couples using current incomes (as opposed to pre‐marriage incomes used in our approach), may generate misleading conclusions.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一份极为丰富的荷兰数据集，该数据集包含七年内所有所得税档案，对收入层面的婚姻匹配进行了分析。我们开发了一种新颖的方法论，直接扩展了先前的研究贡献，以允许高度灵活的匹配模式。通过考察2013年至2019年间发生的所有婚姻，我们发现婚姻模式尤为引人注目。尽管大多数夫妻呈现同型匹配，但少数但显著的群体表现出负向同型匹配。我们还表明，采用标准方法（即考虑所有已婚夫妇的当前收入，而非我们方法中使用的婚前收入）可能会得出误导性结论。

title: Geopolitical risk shocks: When size matters
title_zh: 地缘政治风险冲击：当规模至关重要时
title_primary: 地缘政治风险冲击：当规模至关重要时
title_secondary: Geopolitical risk shocks: When size matters
authors: Davide Brignone, Luca Gambetti, Martino Ricci
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the economic effects of geopolitical risk (GPR) shocks on the US economy, with a focus on non-linear transmission mechanisms. Using a VARX framework, we show that larger positive shocks have a disproportionately greater impact, pointing to the existence of an amplification channel driven by rising uncertainty that leads to sharp declines in private demand and equity prices. In contrast, the prices’ responses are relatively muted, reflecting the offsetting effects of reduced demand and increasing supply-side pressures. Decomposing GPR into Threats and Acts shocks helps explain this result: Threats shocks behave as second-moment uncertainty disturbances that significantly raise oil prices and inflation expectations, exerting upward pressure on domestic prices, while Acts shocks transmit more similarly to first-moment negative demand shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了地缘政治风险（GPR）冲击对美国经济的经济效应，重点关注非线性传导机制。利用VARX框架，我们表明较大的正向冲击具有不成比例的更大影响，指向由不确定性上升驱动的放大渠道的存在，这导致私人需求和股票价格的急剧下降。相比之下，价格的反应相对温和，反映了需求减少与供给侧压力上升的抵消效应。将GPR分解为威胁冲击和行动冲击有助于解释这一结果：威胁冲击表现为二阶矩不确定性扰动，显著推高油价和通胀预期，对国内价格施加上行压力，而行动冲击的传导更类似于一阶矩负向需求冲击。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1776年至1815年间英格兰与威尔士教区官员收集的三个时间点的乡镇级福利支出与供给数据，揭示该时期区域与地方差异。这些数据已与地理信息系统（GIS）制图系统关联，从而能够基于广泛变量绘制教区/乡镇级福利数据地图。通过将数据与1801年及1811年人口普查数据、1815年所得税财产估值进行适当关联，还可对福利供给的普及程度、可负担性及类型进行新的村级估算。研究结果对当前关于济贫法实施区域差异的假说提出了挑战。

title: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
title_zh: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析
title_primary: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析
title_secondary: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
authors: Myrto Kalouptsidi, Yuichi Kitamura, Lucas Lima, Eduardo Souza-Rodrigues
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.
abstract_zh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够恢复效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实结果。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，仅有一小部分反事实结果能被点识别。本文探讨了在此框架下，我们能对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型约束逐步缩小识别集。我们推导了低维对象（如平均福利）作为优化问题参数的边界，并提供了统一有效的推断方法。此外，我们开发了适用于处理此类高维问题的新型可计算工具与算法。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的实证研究，我们展示了识别集的信息量，并评估了（常见）模型约束对结果的影响。

title: Matching property rights and transboundary ecological processes: The case of Norwegian salmon aquaculture
title_zh: 匹配产权与跨界生态过程：挪威鲑鱼养殖的案例
title_primary: 匹配产权与跨界生态过程：挪威鲑鱼养殖的案例
title_secondary: Matching property rights and transboundary ecological processes: The case of Norwegian salmon aquaculture
authors: Adams Ceballos‐Concha, Frank Asche, Andrew Ropicki, Conner Mullally, Jordan Moor
official: 官方在线 2025-11-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Transboundary ecological processes, such as the spread of pests and diseases, require management strategies that align property rights with the spatial scale of these processes. The existing literature is predominantly based on theoretical models and qualitative case studies, and has posited that coordinated management can often mitigate spatial externalities. However, robust causal assessments of the effects of coordinated management remain scarce. To address the issue empirically, we differentiate between the probability of an initial salmon lice infestation (the extensive margin) and the severity of infestation once it occurs (the intensive margin) using a uniquely comprehensive dataset from Norwegian salmon aquaculture. The findings reveal that while ownership concentration does not significantly alter the likelihood of infestation, it substantially reduces severity by enabling coordinated management practices. This divergence demonstrates that firm incentives vary across these two dimensions. Although the empirical setting focuses on salmon lice in salmon aquaculture, the findings carry broader implications for industries facing similar spatial-dynamic externalities. In particular, ownership consolidation can encourage coordinated investments and interventions, potentially reducing the underinvestment typically observed when multiple firms share biologically connected resources.
abstract_zh: 跨界生态过程，如病虫害的传播，要求管理策略与这些过程的空间尺度相匹配，以确保产权安排的一致性。现有文献主要基于理论模型和定性案例研究，提出协调管理往往能缓解空间外部性。然而，关于协调管理效果的稳健因果评估仍然稀缺。为实证探究此问题，我们利用挪威三文鱼养殖业独特而全面的数据集，区分了初始海虱侵染的概率（广度边际）与侵染发生后的严重程度（强度边际）。研究发现，所有权集中并未显著改变侵染发生的可能性，但通过促进协调管理实践，大幅降低了侵染的严重性。这一差异表明，企业激励在这两个维度上存在不同。尽管实证背景聚焦于三文鱼养殖中的海虱问题，但研究结论对面临类似空间动态外部性的行业具有更广泛的启示意义。特别是，所有权整合能够鼓励协调投资与干预措施，可能减少多企业共享生物关联资源时常见的投资不足现象。

title: Does intergenerational financial support increase fertility willingness: evidence from the Chinese General Social survey
title_zh: 代际经济支持是否提高了生育意愿：来自中国综合社会调查的证据
title_primary: 代际经济支持是否提高了生育意愿：来自中国综合社会调查的证据
title_secondary: Does intergenerational financial support increase fertility willingness: evidence from the Chinese General Social survey
authors: Li Jiang Yan Zhang a School of Business, Department of Finance and International Trade, Jianghan University, Wuhan, Chinab School of Economics, Institute of Ecological Civilization 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: China’s demographic structure is undergoing significant strain, characterized by accelerating population ageing and declining birth rates. The increasing female labour market participation has heightened the significance of intergenerational support in fertility decisions. Despite extensive evidence on intergenerational caregiving effects, the interplay between financial transfers and fertility willingness remains poorly understood. Based on data from the China General Social Survey (CGSS), this paper employs ordered probit/logit model and IV ordered probit model to empirically examine the impact of intergenerational financial support on fertility intentions. The results show parental financial support significantly affects both individuals’ desired number of children and the gap between their desired and actual fertility intentions. The effect follows a pattern of ‘initially negative, then positive’, with diminishing marginal returns across different level of fertility willingness. Individuals primarily have more willingness to have one additional child after having intergenerational financial support. Our robustness checks support these findings. Heterogeneity analyses further indicate that intergenerational financial support has a significant effect on the fertility intentions of those aged 31–35, without housing property or with two and more properties. And such effects are evident in families at middle- and high-income level, especially in one-child families, and in regions with above-average fertility rates.
abstract_zh: 中国人口结构正面临显著压力，表现为人口老龄化加速与出生率持续下降。随着女性劳动参与率提升，代际支持在生育决策中的重要性日益凸显。尽管已有大量研究关注代际照料的影响，但经济转移支付与生育意愿之间的相互作用机制仍不明确。基于中国综合社会调查（CGSS）数据，本文采用有序probit/logit模型及工具变量有序probit模型，实证检验代际经济支持对生育意愿的影响。结果表明：父母经济支持显著影响个体的理想子女数量及其与生育意愿之间的差距，且该效应呈现"先负后正"的形态，在不同生育意愿水平上存在边际效应递减特征。代际经济支持主要促使个体增加一个子女的生育意愿。稳健性检验支持上述结论。异质性分析进一步表明，代际经济支持对31-35岁群体、无住房产权或拥有两套及以上住房者的生育意愿影响显著；该效应在中高收入家庭、独生子女家庭以及生育率高于平均水平的地区尤为明显。

title: Examining the role of artwork orientation on Picasso painting auction prices
title_zh: 探究画作方向对毕加索画作拍卖价格的影响
title_primary: 探究画作方向对毕加索画作拍卖价格的影响
title_secondary: Examining the role of artwork orientation on Picasso painting auction prices
authors: Stephen Norman Howard Smith University of Washington, Tacoma, WA, USA
official: 官方在线 2025-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study employs hedonic pricing models to investigate the effects of compositional factors on auction prices by utilizing a comprehensive dataset of over 1,300 Pablo Picasso paintings that integrates auction data and art historical references. The novel contribution of this study is the analysis of painting orientation (horizontal, vertical or square) on auction price while controlling for the subject matter of each artwork, a methodological approach previously unexplored in the literature. Results indicate that painting orientation significantly influences auction prices independently of subject matter, surface area, time period, auction location and painting surface. These findings highlight the importance of including orientation in hedonic pricing models and offer practical insights for collectors, art investors and auction houses.
